title: Fart Plugin
description: FartPlugin is the Paper/Bukkit plugin counterpart of the popular Fart Mod, bringing fart-powered speed boosts and comedic effects to Minecraft 1.21.4 servers.
body:
💨 FartPlugin – The Plugin Counterpart to Fart Mod (Minecraft 1.21.4, Paper/Bukkit)

FartPlugin brings the absurd hilarity of the Fart Mod to Paper and Bukkit servers! When players sneak (Shift), they unleash a powerful fart that propels them forward with a speed boost, complete with sound and particle effects. Fully configurable and permission-controlled, this lightweight plugin adds a ridiculous but entertaining twist to your server's gameplay.
